arena.name: BUET campus
arena.subtitle: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology

location.name: Central Library
location.clue: Silence is the rule here, and so is borrowing.

location.name: Administrative Building
location.clue: Every important form ends up on a desk here.
The place where official letters and signatures live.

location.name: Central Mosque
location.clue: A calm place where the day is measured in prayers.
The call to prayer starts here, five times a day.

location.name: Shaheed Minar
location.clue: Flowers are laid here every February.
A monument that remembers the language movement.

location.name: Central Cafeteria
location.clue: Tea, snacks and the loudest conversations on campus.
Hungry students always end up here.

location.name: Main Gate
location.clue: Everyone enters through here, nobody ignores it.
The first thing a visitor sees on campus.

location.name: Sports Ground
location.clue: Wide open grass where matches begin at sunset.
Goalposts, a running track and lots of cheering.

location.name: Auditorium
location.clue: Seminars, cultural nights and convocations happen here.
A big hall with rows of seats and a stage.
